interface.longDescription:
Wimbly is an AI business-development analyst for partners at professional-services firms. This package contains its plugin for Claude and Codex.

The current preview includes the onboarding skill, whose instructions are documented in the repository. An enrolled Wimbly account is required. Account connection is awaiting deployment and live sign-in testing.

publication.release_notes: Introduce Wimbly generally and link to individual skill instructions. Live account connection remains pending.
